title: 高速道岔組裝~High-speed turnout assembly
focus: 道岔線形組裝公差與輪軌導引~Turnout alignment assembly tolerances and wheel guidance
summary: 高速道岔組裝以「道岔線形組裝公差與輪軌導引」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。高速道岔不是單一轉向角，而是尖軌、導曲線與轍叉協同導引；各構件公差需回到共同中心線和輪對通過包絡。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。~This course develops turnout alignment assembly tolerances and wheel guidance through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. A high-speed turnout is not a single angle but coordinated guidance by switch rails, closure curves and crossing; component tolerances need one centreline and wheelset passage envelope. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
history: 本課把高速道岔組裝放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。高速道岔不是單一轉向角，而是尖軌、導曲線與轍叉協同導引；各構件公差需回到共同中心線和輪對通過包絡。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。~The course places High-speed turnout assembly in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. A high-speed turnout is not a single angle but coordinated guidance by switch rails, closure curves and crossing; component tolerances need one centreline and wheelset passage envelope. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.
example: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：n=18 1；y=atan(1/n)*180/pi=3.17983 degree。只把 n 增加百分之十，y=2.89127 degree。模型邊界：道岔號數定義為分岔角正切的倒數；其他號數慣例不適用；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=45 m/s, R=1800 m；y=v**2/R=1.125 m/s2。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=1.36125 m/s2。模型邊界：固定分歧速度及圓曲線半徑；不含超高與車體滾動；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。~This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: n=18 1; y=atan(1/n)*180/pi=3.17983 degree. Increasing only n with a ten-percent increase gives y=2.89127 degree. Boundary: Turnout number is defined as reciprocal tangent of divergence angle; other numbering conventions do not apply; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=45 m/s, R=1800 m; y=v**2/R=1.125 m/s2. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=1.36125 m/s2. Boundary: Constant diverging speed and circular radius; cant and body roll are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.

units.anchor: 道岔分岔角估算~Turnout divergence angle
units.title: 道岔分岔角估算~Turnout divergence angle
units.mechanism: 分岔角與道岔號數的定義需一致。本模型把 n 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出減少為 2.89127 degree。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。道岔號數定義為分岔角正切的倒數；其他號數慣例不適用。使用中心線方向與號數定義作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；混用不同號數定義會錯配構件，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Divergence angle requires a consistent turnout-number definition. In this model, n is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output decreases to 2.89127 degree. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Turnout number is defined as reciprocal tangent of divergence angle; other numbering conventions do not apply. Use centreline directions and turnout-number definition as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Mixed turnout-number conventions mismatch components; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：n=18 1；y=atan(1/n)*180/pi=3.17983 degree。只把 n 增加百分之十，y=2.89127 degree。模型邊界：道岔號數定義為分岔角正切的倒數；其他號數慣例不適用；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: n=18 1; y=atan(1/n)*180/pi=3.17983 degree. Increasing only n with a ten-percent increase gives y=2.89127 degree. Boundary: Turnout number is defined as reciprocal tangent of divergence angle; other numbering conventions do not apply; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以中心線方向與號數定義區分模型與觀察，先用模型兩中心線方位、號數定義及角度量測建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「道岔分岔角估算」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use centreline directions and turnout-number definition to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using model centreline directions, numbering definition and measured angle, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Turnout divergence angle. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 混用不同號數定義會錯配構件。這個失效與「道岔分岔角估算」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查中心線方向與號數定義，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Mixed turnout-number conventions mismatch components. This failure and a measurement bias in Turnout divergence angle can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check centreline directions and turnout-number definition rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：混用不同號數定義會錯配構件~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Mixed turnout-number conventions mismatch components.
units.practice: 重算「道岔分岔角估算」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出道岔號數定義為分岔角正切的倒數；其他號數慣例不適用如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由混用不同號數定義會錯配構件造成偏離的合成觀察，以中心線方向與號數定義說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Turnout divergence angle, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Turnout number is defined as reciprocal tangent of divergence angle; other numbering conventions do not apply. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Mixed turnout-number conventions mismatch components. Explain which evidence in centreline directions and turnout-number definition distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 導曲線橫向加速~Closure-curve lateral acceleration
units.title: 導曲線橫向加速~Closure-curve lateral acceleration
units.mechanism: 分歧路徑速度與導曲線半徑共同決定幾何橫向需求。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1.36125 m/s2。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。固定分歧速度及圓曲線半徑；不含超高與車體滾動。使用分歧速度與曲率作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；直股速度不能直接當作側股速度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Diverging speed and closure radius jointly determine geometric lateral demand. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1.36125 m/s2. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Constant diverging speed and circular radius; cant and body roll are excluded. Use diverging speed and curvature as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Through-route speed cannot simply become diverging-route speed; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=1.36125 m/s2. Boundary: Constant diverging speed and circular radius; cant and body roll are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

units.anchor: 兩端座標閉合~Endpoint coordinate closure
units.title: 兩端座標閉合~Endpoint coordinate closure
units.mechanism: 道岔端點閉合應保留方向與共同座標。本模型把 dx 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 3.72022 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。端點在同一平面座標系；長度不保留修正方向。使用獨立控制點測量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；整組偏移可被內部相對量測忽略，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Turnout endpoint closure needs direction and common coordinates. In this model, dx is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 3.72022 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Endpoints share one planar coordinate system; magnitude does not retain correction direction. Use independent control-point survey as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Internal relative measurements can miss whole-assembly displacement; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：dx=2 mm, dy=3 mm；y=sqrt(dx**2+dy**2)=3.60555 mm。只把 dx 增加百分之十，y=3.72022 mm。模型邊界：端點在同一平面座標系；長度不保留修正方向；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: dx=2 mm, dy=3 mm; y=sqrt(dx**2+dy**2)=3.60555 mm. Increasing only dx with a ten-percent increase gives y=3.72022 mm. Boundary: Endpoints share one planar coordinate system; magnitude does not retain correction direction; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以獨立控制點測量區分模型與觀察，先用獨立控制點、東北向殘差及閉合向量建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「兩端座標閉合」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use independent control-point survey to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

units.title: 支承高差坡度~Support-level slope
units.mechanism: 連續支承高程影響道岔平順而非只看單點高度。本模型把 dz 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.55 mm/m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。高差與長度採同一路徑及基準；以平均坡度代表該段。使用各長岔枕高程作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；長枕局部懸空會在載重後改變線形，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Support-level continuity governs smoothness beyond individual point heights. In this model, dz is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.55 mm/m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Height difference and length share one path and datum; the result is segment-average slope. Use levels of successive bearers as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A locally unsupported bearer changes geometry under load; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：dz=2 mm, L=4 m；y=dz/L=0.5 mm/m。只把 dz 增加百分之十，y=0.55 mm/m。模型邊界：高差與長度採同一路徑及基準；以平均坡度代表該段；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: dz=2 mm, L=4 m; y=dz/L=0.5 mm/m. Increasing only dz with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.55 mm/m. Boundary: Height difference and length share one path and datum; the result is segment-average slope; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以各長岔枕高程區分模型與觀察，先用各岔枕模型高程、支承位置及載重前後剖面建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「支承高差坡度」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use levels of successive bearers to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Support-level slope. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

This failure and a measurement bias in Support-level slope can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check levels of successive bearers rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Survey temperature correction. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 日照造成的溫差會混入組裝誤差。這個失效與「量測溫差補正」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查構件溫度與基準長度，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Sun-driven temperature difference appears as assembly error. This failure and a measurement bias in Survey temperature correction can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check component temperature and reference length rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：日照造成的溫差會混入組裝誤差~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Sun-driven temperature difference appears as assembly error.

Explain which evidence in component temperature and reference length distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 檢驗覆蓋清單~Inspection checklist coverage
units.title: 檢驗覆蓋清單~Inspection checklist coverage
units.mechanism: 清單完成比例不等於系統安全通過率。本模型把 done 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加一個整數單位，輸出增加為 92 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。完成與必需項的定義固定；數量比例不替代關鍵項判定。使用每項驗證證據與未完成項作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；用完成率取代關鍵項未通過會造成假結案，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Checklist completion is not a system safety pass rate. In this model, done is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. An increase of one whole unit means the output increases to 92 percent. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Definitions of completed and required items are fixed; count fraction does not replace critical-item decisions. Use evidence for each check and open items as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Completion percentage can hide a failed critical item; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：done=45 count, required=50 count；y=done/required*100=90 percent。只把 done 增加一個整數單位，y=92 percent。模型邊界：完成與必需項的定義固定；數量比例不替代關鍵項判定；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: done=45 count, required=50 count; y=done/required*100=90 percent. Increasing only done with an increase of one whole unit gives y=92 percent. Boundary: Definitions of completed and required items are fixed; count fraction does not replace critical-item decisions; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以每項驗證證據與未完成項區分模型與觀察，先用每項模型證據、未完成原因與關鍵項獨立判定建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「檢驗覆蓋清單」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use evidence for each check and open items to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using evidence for each model check, open-item reasons and independent critical-item decisions, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Inspection checklist coverage. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 用完成率取代關鍵項未通過會造成假結案。這個失效與「檢驗覆蓋清單」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查每項驗證證據與未完成項，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Completion percentage can hide a failed critical item. This failure and a measurement bias in Inspection checklist coverage can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check evidence for each check and open items rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
